primary_hexagram.name: Hexagram 41
primary_hexagram.judgment: In (what is denoted by) Sun, if there be sincerity (in him who employs it), there will be great good fortune : — freedom from error ; firmness and correctness that can be maintained ; and advantage in every movement that shall be made. In what shall this (sincerity in the exercise of Sun) be employed? (Even) in sacrifice two baskets of grain, (though there be nothing else), may be presented.
primary_hexagram.image: (The trigram representing) a mountain and beneath it that for the waters of a marsh form Sun. The superior man, in accordance with this, restrains his wrath and represses his desires.

relating_hexagram.name: Hexagram 44
relating_hexagram.judgment: Kau shows a female who is bold and strong. It will not be good to marry (such) a female.
relating_hexagram.image: (The trigram representing) wind and that for the sky above it form Kau. The sovereign, in accordance with this, delivers his charges, and promulgates his announcements throughout the four quarters (of the kingdom).
